profile.ja:
ふうま一門の対魔忍。木霊を操る木遁遣い。
木霊は無機物に取り憑いて自在に動かす、武器を強化する、索敵するなど、きぬの望みに応えて様々な働きをしてくれる。
出雲家はふうま一門の中でも名門であり、突出した忍法使いを何人も輩出している。
きぬもその一人。
温和で優しい性格だが怒らせると非常に怖い（絹でもあり鬼怒でもある）。
同じふうまの対魔忍である佐郷文庫と夫婦となり娘・鶴を生む。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin of the Fuuma clan, a wood jutsu user who manipulates wood spirits. The wood spirits can possess inorganic objects, move freely, enhance weapons, and perform reconnaissance, all in response to her wishes. The Izumo family is a renowned house within the Fuuma clan, having produced many exceptional ninja. Kinu is one of them. She has a gentle and kind personality, but can be very intimidating when angered, as her name suggests both silk and devil's wrath. She married a fellow Fuuma Taimanin, Bunko, and gave birth to a daughter named Tsuru.

text.ja: 出雲きぬ、参りました。この格好ですか？　ふふ、アウトローな雰囲気ですが、格好良いと思いませんか？
text.en: I'm Izumo Kinu. I've arrived. What do you think of this outfit? It has a bit of an outlaw vibe, but I think it looks good, don't you?

text.ja: 普段は刀を使って戦うから、拳銃を使うのは新鮮ですね。威力は低いですが、手軽に扱えると考えると悪くないです
text.en: I usually use a sword in battle, so it's refreshing to use a gun. The firepower is low, but it's easy to handle, so it's not bad.

text.ja: 文庫様……夫にこの服を見せたらなんとも不思議な顔をしていました。ただ、格好良いとは言って貰えましたよ
text.en: Bunko... when I showed him this outfit, he had a rather puzzled expression. But he did say it looks good on me.

text.ja: 対魔忍スーツは動きやすさを最優先したデザインですが、スーツにコートは少し動きづらいですね。でも、潜入には便利でしょうか？
text.en: Taimanin suits are designed with mobility in mind, but adding a coat makes it a bit harder to move. However, it might be useful for infiltration.

text.ja: この拳銃、普通の物と明らかに違いますよね……？　何というか、華美な装飾というか……でも、こだわりを感じます
text.en: This gun is clearly different from a normal one... it has a decorative flair to it, but I can sense the attention to detail that went into making it.

text.ja: 私が操る木霊は無機物に取憑いてくれるから、銃弾に取憑いて貰うとすごい動きをしてくれるんです。ご覧になりますか？
text.en: The wood spirits I control can possess inorganic objects, so if I have them possess bullets, they can move in some amazing ways. Would you like to see it?

text.ja: 娘の鶴が拳銃に妙に関心を示してるんです。私とも夫とも違う、遠距離を得意とする対魔忍になるのかも知れませんね
text.en: My daughter, Tsuru, has been showing a strange interest in guns. She might become a Taimanin who excels at long-range combat, unlike her parents.

text.ja: 中々アウトローな物言いは上手くできませんが……怒った時の迫力はよく出ているって言われちゃって、少し複雑です……
text.en: I'm not very good at talking like an outlaw, but... I've been told that my intimidating aura when I'm angry is quite convincing, which makes me a bit complicated...
